summary: Verified the follow-up behavior change: 'Duplicate at current pricing' from the frozen-edit warning modal now produces a FRESH generated Estimate # (no '-COPY' suffix). End-to-end UI test PASSED all 5 assertions.

test_results.1_login_and_open_frozen_v1: PASS — admin login OK, Load → Saved Quotes → Team scope shown, exact-match row 'FROZEN-TEST-V1' located (id bb2518ee-702f-4208-91a2-1d270462fcfe). Pre-edit est#='FROZEN-TEST-V1', frozen-chip visible.
test_results.2_material_edit_triggers_warn: PASS — after 4.5s settle, setting input-qty-0=999 opens [data-testid='frozen-edit-warn'].
test_results.3_duplicate_generates_fresh_est_num: PASS — clicking frozen-duplicate-btn produces est#='SA-260617-174137'. Matches pattern ^[A-Za-z]+-\d{6}-\d{6}$ (initials 'SA' from 'SPOT Admin' user). Does NOT contain 'COPY'. NOT equal to 'FROZEN-TEST-V1'.
test_results.4_duplicated_tab_is_non_frozen: PASS — active tab data-active='1', data-frozen='0'. No [data-testid='frozen-chip'] present in the Estimate Info header.

critical_code_review_comments: duplicateFrozenAtCurrent() correctly chains copyQuote → generateEstNum(initials) → updateQuote(copy.id, est_num) → replaceState into active tab. The fresh est# now persists end-to-end (UI and server).

Initials resolved to 'SA' (SPOT Admin) — the review-request example was 'ADM' but the format.js implementation derives initials from first letters of name parts, so 'SPOT Admin' → 'SA'. This is consistent and not a defect.

Pre-existing console warning unrelated to this change: React 'mixing shorthand/non-shorthand border styles during rerender' in TabBar.jsx frozen tab styling. Cosmetic; recommend normalizing border vs borderBottom inline styles.

Pre-existing infra issue from iteration_33 still applies: /api/auth/entra/login returns HTTP 500 (not 503) when ENTRA_TENANT_ID is a placeholder. Did not affect this test (used [data-testid='login-submit-btn']) but flagging again.
test_credentials: admin@standardprinting.com / spot-admin-2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Initials resolve to 'SA' (SPOT Admin).
seed_data_creation: Created one server-side duplicate of FROZEN-TEST-V1 as 'SA-260617-174137' (non-frozen, pinned to current pricing). FROZEN-TEST-V1 (id bb2518ee) baseline is intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: There are now MULTIPLE 'FROZEN-TEST-V1*' rows in the team-saved Load list (the original 'FROZEN-TEST-V1', the legacy 'FROZEN-TEST-V1-COPY' from iteration_33, and now 'SA-260617-174137' from this iteration). When locating the frozen row, always match est# EXACTLY === 'FROZEN-TEST-V1'. Use [data-testid='login-submit-btn'] (not 'Sign in' text — that matches Microsoft SSO and 500s). After clicking 'Duplicate at current pricing', wait ≥4.5s before reading the est# input (server roundtrip: copyQuote then updateQuote(est_num) then replaceState).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. The 1-line behavior change is verified working in the UI: duplicateFrozenAtCurrent generates a fresh INITIALS-YYMMDD-HHMMSS est# via generateEstNum(initials), persists it through updateQuote, and replaceState wires it into the active tab. Observed est# = 'SA-260617-174137'.
